studyRepair.cause: A Library render captures empty Study cards; its delayed effect observes a later mutable active lifecycle and clears that newer activation.
studyRepair.fix: Capture activation ID with the render snapshot and require it still matches before empty-session cleanup.
preservedContracts: current activation with no cards still closes
replaced Study activation survives old effects
owner and query generation guards unchanged
studyRepair.sourceReview: Independent read-only review GO before ordinary browser acceptance

nativeCrash.status: Pinned repaired browser verified by ordinary application matrix and exact failure repeat; no claim of minimal A/B crash reproduction

nativeCorrelation.test: classic light Zen card keeps both faces opaque and readable at desktop
nativeCorrelation.scope: Native crash strongly correlated with this failed test; instruction pattern matches upstream report, not a symbolized stack or proof for all earlier failures.

nativeCrash.newToolchainVerification: ordinary 72/72 and exact 30/30; retries0, snapshot updates none

reviewedGolden.reason: Reviewed deterministic native text rasterization change after Firefox engine upgrade; background text differs, controls/content/layout retained. This is visual acceptance, not proof of font-loading causality.

regressionBeforeFix.result: Expected failure proves old empty effect clears new Study
